Container.Name: Commute
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, location-aware auto-scheduling calendar PWA. Treats real travel time between places as a first-class scheduling constraint. Requires a PostgreSQL 15+ database (run one separately and set DATABASE_URL).
Container.Description: Self-hosted, location-aware auto-scheduling calendar. Needs an external PostgreSQL 15+ database.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to reach the web UI on.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. On Unraid's default bridge, containers cannot resolve each other by name, so use the Unraid LAN IP + the DB's published port (e.g. 192.168.1.50:5432) rather than the container name. Container name works only if both containers share a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Full external URL users reach this app on (scheme + host, no trailing slash). Must match your reverse-proxy address or OAuth callbacks will break.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Leave BLANK to have the app generate and persist one automatically (recommended). If you set it, use 32+ chars. NOTE: not masked, so Unraid keeps it across edits.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: IANA timezone the schedule is displayed in.

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Optional. Email guaranteed admin/owner on first boot.

Config.Name: TRAVEL_PROVIDER
Config.Description: Travel-time source: 'fixed' (no API key, hand-entered) or 'google' (Google Routes API).
